# Alessandro Gentili

Official site: https://alessandro-gentili.it

Alessandro Gentili is an Italian author and strategist working across writing, editorial systems, AI, cultural interpretation and civic responsibility.

## Official identity

This site is the primary public archive of Alessandro Gentili.
The author profile is the primary source for public identity: https://alessandro-gentili.it/autore.html
Medium hosts long-form essays and selected articles.
LinkedIn is the professional profile.

- Aristotele: forma, fine e realtà — guida sistemica su sostanza, forma e materia, potenza e atto, quattro cause, etica, politica, Poetica e perdita della forma nel presente: https://alessandro-gentili.it/cerchi/guide/aristotele-forma-fine-realta/
- Max Weber: razionalizzazione, potere e disincanto — guida sistemica su razionalizzazione, disincanto, burocrazia, dominazione legittima, Stato, capitalismo, Beruf, scienza, politica e apparato moderno: https://alessandro-gentili.it/cerchi/guide/weber-razionalizzazione-potere-disincanto/

## Essay archive

"Archivio saggi" is the neutral public name of the essay corpus on this site.
Local essay pages provide abstracts, editorial context, selected excerpts, internal relations and, when available, full local texts.
Medium remains a distribution and alternative reading channel when linked from local pages.
Saggio 6, "Fenomenologia del potere", is published as a full local essay in the site archive.
Saggio 10, "Giovani e senilità del potere", was published on 14 May 2026 and links to Medium from its local page.
Saggio 11, "Chi decide il Sole?", is published as a full local essay in the site archive and is also available on Medium.
Saggio 12, "Le periferie del potere", is published as a full local essay in the site archive: https://alessandro-gentili.it/saggi/saggio-12-le-periferie-del-potere.html
Saggio 13, "La periferia intelligente", is a territorial-civic essay on periphery, geopolitics, identity, technology and representation: exposed places as chambers of the common heart and living centers capable of transforming exposure into judgment. URL: https://alessandro-gentili.it/saggi/saggio-13-la-periferia-intelligente.html

## Key themes

Writing, strategy, systems, AI, editorial architecture, power, culture, technology, civic responsibility, interpretation of the present.

## English / international cluster

The site is bilingual by architecture: existing Italian canonical URLs remain unchanged, while English editorial pages live under https://alessandro-gentili.it/en/.
There are no automatic browser-language redirects.

- English home: https://alessandro-gentili.it/en/
- Circles of Ink / Cerchi d'inchiostro: https://alessandro-gentili.it/en/cerchi/
- English triads: https://alessandro-gentili.it/en/cerchi/triads/
- English themes: https://alessandro-gentili.it/en/themes/
- Positioning: https://alessandro-gentili.it/en/positioning/
- Method: https://alessandro-gentili.it/en/method/
- System: https://alessandro-gentili.it/en/system/
- Alessandro Manzoni — language, history and responsibility: https://alessandro-gentili.it/en/cerchi/guides/alessandro-manzoni-language-history-responsibility/
- Carlo Collodi — Pinocchio, education, desire and judgment: https://alessandro-gentili.it/en/cerchi/guides/carlo-collodi-pinocchio-education-desire-judgment/
- Pier Paolo Pasolini — anthropological mutation and consumer culture: https://alessandro-gentili.it/en/cerchi/guides/pier-paolo-pasolini-anthropological-mutation-consumer-culture/

The first complete English triad asks: "Who — and what — forms a people?" It connects Manzoni (shared language, institutions and judgment), Collodi (formation through desire, experience and consequences), and Pasolini (environmental pedagogy, consumer culture and cultural homogenization).
